the identification of new drugs for the treatment of hypertension.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the lack of effectiveness to lower blood pressure of LY53857 indicates that blockade of central and vascular serotoninergic receptors is not a necessary condition to lower blood pressure.
the blockade of central serotonin receptors is a necessary, but not a sufficient, mechanism for the antihypertensive effect of serotonin antagonists in the spontaneously hypertensives rat.
